ops.oldText: IBM grants Customer a nonexclusive, revocable license to use the Base Components solely in connection with the Services as provided under this Agreement.
ops.newText: IBM grants Customer, its Affiliates, and contractors acting on Customer's behalf a nonexclusive license to use the Base Components solely in connection with the Services as provided under this Agreement. Such license is irrevocable except upon termination of this Agreement or the applicable Service Option Attachment for Customer's uncured material breach.

input.comment: [Playbook] We have extended the Base Components licence to our Affiliates and to contractors acting on our behalf and removed revocability at IBM's discretion, so the licence ends only on termination for our uncured material breach. This matches our playbook position that a licence must cover Affiliates and contractors and may not be revocable at will; if helpful, we can instead cover Affiliates on written notice to IBM.
input.summary: Extend § 12.1 licence to Customer Affiliates and contractors and remove at-will revocability.
